statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of transient neurological deficits and palpitations
There is concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation as a potential etiology of transient cerebral ischemic attacks
The patient has a personal history of TIA and cerebral infarction
The patient has unspecified cardiac arrhythmia
Diagnosis codes G45.9, I49.9, and Z86.73 were submitted
The claim was denied with reason code PR-204
Prolonged cardiac event monitoring is indicated to capture intermittent rhythm disturbances that may not be evident on standard electrocardiography
